army_rules.name: Prioritised Efficiency
army_rules.rules_text:
As the Kin truth describes, Luck Has Need Toil earns. The Kinhosts' ability to efficiently switch their strategic footing embodies this wisdom. It results from swift assessments of a foe's possessions, how best to seize them for the Kindred's need and then to stubbornly toil to hold them against counterattacks.

If your Army Faction is LEAGUES OF VOTANN, LEAGUES OF VOTANN units from your army have one of two abilities: Hostile Acquisition or Fortify Takeover. During the battle, which ability those units have will change depending on how many Yield points (YP) you currently have.

At the start of the battle, your units have the Hostile Acquisition ability until the start of your next Command phase. At the end of your Command phase, if you have fewer than 7YP, your units have Hostile Acquisition until the start of your next Command phase. At the end of your Command phase, if you have 7YP or more, your units have Fortify Takeover until the start of your next Command phase.

From the second battle round onwards, you gain 1 additional YP for each of the following conditions you satisfy: you control one or more objective markers not within your deployment zone; you control two or more objective markers not within your deployment zone; you control more objective markers than your opponent; you control more objective markers than your opponent controlled at the end of their turn.

In your turn, YP gained in this way are always gained before checking which ability LEAGUES OF VOTANN units from your army have. Whenever a rule allows you to spend YP, reduce the number of YP you have by that amount. You cannot go below 0YP unless that rule states otherwise.

options.name: Hostile Acquisition
options.rules_text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of one or more objective markers and not within the enemy deployment zone, add 1 to the Hit roll. You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.

options.name: Fortify Takeover
options.rules_text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, if this unit is within range of one or more objective markers you control, add 1 to the Hit roll. Each time an attack targets this unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than this unit's Toughness characteristic and this unit is not a VEHICLE, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

options.name: Yield Points
options.rules_text: At the end of each player's Command phase, you gain 1YP if you control one or more objective markers within your deployment zone and one or more objective markers not within your deployment zone. At the end of each player's Command phase, you gain 1YP if you control one or more objective markers not within your deployment zone and not within your opponent's deployment zone.

rule.name: Martial Levee
rule.rules_text: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, you gain 1YP.

enhancements.name: Oathbound Speculator
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time the bearer's unit is selected to shoot or fight, you can spend 3YP. If you do, until the end of the phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

options.name: Oathbound Speculator - Spend 3YP
options.rules_text: Spend 3YP: add 1 to Wound rolls until end of phase.

enhancements.name: Dead Reckoning
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. At the end of the turn, if the bearer is on the battlefield and you spent no YP in that turn, you can gain 1YP.

enhancements.name: Iron Ambassador
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model equipped with an Autoch-pattern combi-bolter only. Once per battle, when the bearer's unit is selected to shoot, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, spend up to 3YP and, until the end of the phase, add the number of YP you just spent to the Damage characteristic of the bearer's ranged weapons.
restrictions: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model equipped with an Autoch-pattern combi-bolter only.

options.name: Iron Ambassador - Spend 1YP
options.rules_text: Spend 1YP: add 1 to Damage for the bearer's ranged weapons until end of phase.

options.name: Iron Ambassador - Spend 2YP
options.rules_text: Spend 2YP: add 2 to Damage for the bearer's ranged weapons until end of phase.

options.name: Iron Ambassador - Spend 3YP
options.rules_text: Spend 3YP: add 3 to Damage for the bearer's ranged weapons until end of phase.

enhancements.name: Ancestral Crest
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Once per turn, when you target the bearer's unit with the Command Re-roll Stratagem, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, spend 1YP and reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

stratagems.name: Void Hardened
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Honour of the Hold
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2 instead.

options.name: Honour of the Hold - Standard
options.rules_text: Improve melee AP by 1.

options.name: Honour of the Hold - Spend 3YP
options.rules_text: Spend 3YP: improve melee AP by 2 instead.

stratagems.name: Ordered Retreat
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Ancestral Sentence
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 3YP. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.

options.name: Ancestral Sentence - Standard
options.rules_text: Ranged weapons gain Sustained Hits 1.

options.name: Ancestral Sentence - Spend 3YP
options.rules_text: Spend 3YP: ranged weapons gain Sustained Hits 2 instead.

stratagems.name: Huntr's Mark
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Reactive Reprisal
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, can only target that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

rule.name: Assailed from Every Angle
rule.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN units from your army have the following ability: Guerrilla Adepts: In your Shooting phase, just after this unit is selected to shoot, this unit can use this ability. If it does, select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). Until the end of the phase, attacks made by models in this unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and, after resolving those attacks, if one or more of those attacks hit that enemy unit, until the start of your next Shooting phase, that enemy unit is assailed (this simply labels that unit for the purposes of this ability and some Enhancements and Stratagems). If that unit is already assailed, until the start of your next Shooting phase, it is also pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

enhancements.name: Eye for Weakness
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets an assailed unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Writ of Acquisition
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer's unit has shot, you gain 1YP for each assailed enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks (to a maximum of 3YP).

enhancements.name: Surgical Saboteur
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer's unit has shot, select one MONSTER or VEHICLE unit hit by one or more of those attacks; until the start of your next Shooting phase, that unit is pinned.

enhancements.name: Nomad Strategist
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, you can spend up to 4YP. Select one HERNKYN unit from your army, and, for every 2YP you just spent, select up to one additional HERNKYN unit from your army. You can remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units (excluding assailed units).

stratagems.name: Adaptable Avarice
stratagems.when: Start of any phase, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend any number of YP. Once you have done so, if you have 6 or fewer YP until the start of your next turn, units from your army have Hostile Acquisition instead.

stratagems.name: Frontier Momentum
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HERNKYN unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Exposed Flaws
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One HERNKYN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem and/or if that attack targets an assailed unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Ranger Tactics
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if that attack targets an assailed unit and/or if your unit has the HERNKYN keyword, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Claimstaker Reflex
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army (excluding ARTILLERY and VEHICLE units) that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.
restrictions: A unit cannot embark within a TRANSPORT as part of this move.

stratagems.name: Dispersed Formation
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY or LEAGUES OF VOTANN MOUNTED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability and each time a ranged attack targets your unit, models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

rule.name: Fury from the Dèlve
rule.rules_text: CHTHONIAN BESERKS units from your army have the Deep Strike ability.

enhancements.name: Dèlvewere Navigator
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. In the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly CTHONIAN BESERKS unit visible to the bearer and then spend any number of YP. Return one destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) to that unit and then, for every 2YP you just spent, return up to one additional destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) to that unit.

enhancements.name: Multiwave System Jammer
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Once per battle, in your Movement phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly CTHONIAN unit that is in Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Quake Supervisor
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN ARTILLERY units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability, and each time one of those ARTILLERY units makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit visible to the bearer, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Piledriver
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Each time the bearer's unit is selected to fight, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, spend up to 2YP and, until the end of the phase, add the number of YP you just spent to the Damage characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

options.name: Piledriver - Spend 1YP
options.rules_text: Spend 1YP: add 1 to Damage for the bearer's melee weapons until end of phase.

options.name: Piledriver - Spend 2YP
options.rules_text: Spend 2YP: add 2 to Damage for the bearer's melee weapons until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Cyberstimm Infusion
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One CTHONIAN BESERKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

options.name: Cyberstimm Infusion - Standard
options.rules_text: Re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

options.name: Cyberstimm Infusion - Spend 2YP
options.rules_text: Spend 2YP: re-roll all Wound rolls instead.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Force
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Piles In or Consolidates, each model in that unit can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

stratagems.name: Augmented Assault
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One CTHONIAN BESERKS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend up to 2YP. Until the end of the turn, add X" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, where X is the number of YP you spent during this use of this Stratagem, and your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Tectonic Fracture
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a CTHONIAN EARTHSHAKERS unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That CTHONIAN EARTHSHAKERS unit.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of your unit's attacks this phase. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, subtract 2 from that unit's Move characteristic and, if you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that unit.

stratagems.name: Wavewrecker Buttress
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, if units from your army have Hostile Acquisition.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Hidden Accessways
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One CTHONIAN BESERKS, HEARTHKYN WARRIORS or HERNKYN YAEGIRS unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

rule.name: Mobile Sensor Relays
rule.rules_text:
LEAGUES OF VOTANN TRANSPORT units from your army have the following ability:

Firebase Control (Aura): While a friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit is wholly within 6" of this TRANSPORT, ranged weapons equipped by models in that INFANTRY unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

enhancements.name: Tactical Alchemy
enhancements.rules_text: KÂHL model only. In your Command phase, if the bearer's unit is within range of one or more objective markers you control that are not within your deployment zone, you can spend 1YP. If you do, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Trivârg Cyber Implant
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer's unit is selected to shoot, if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, or if you spend 2YP, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.

enhancements.name: Precursive Judgement
enhancements.rules_text: KÂHL model only. While the bearer's unit is wholly within 6" of one or more friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN TRANSPORT units, you can target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP and hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ while resolving that Stratagem.

enhancements.name: Signature Restoration
enhancements.rules_text: IRON-MASTER model only. Each time a friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN model is repaired using the bearer's Forgewrought Expertise ability, that model regains 1 additional lost wound.

stratagems.name: Secure Positions
stratagems.when: End of any of your phases.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN TRANSPORT unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of your TRANSPORT. That unit cannot declare a charge in the same turn, but can otherwise act normally in the remainder of the turn.

stratagems.name: Bastion Running
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HEKATON LAND FORTRESS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: Illuminated Priority
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN VEHICLE unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That LEAGUES OF VOTANN VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Inexorable Efficiency
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Opportunistic Escalation
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, if units from your army have Hostile Acquisition.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding HEKATON LAND FORTRESS units) that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Vengeance Flare
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Select one friendly KÂPRICUS or SAGITAUR unit within 6" of your INFANTRY unit. If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, you can select one friendly HEKATON LAND FORTRESS unit within 6" of your INFANTRY unit instead. The selected unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase. When doing so, models in the selected unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).

rule.name: Optimal Application
rule.rules_text:
At the end of your Command phase, you gain 1YP for each objective marker you control that is not within your deployment zone and has one or more IRON-MASTER and/or MEMNYR STRATEGIST models from your army within range of it (to a maximum of 2YP gained from this Detachment rule per turn).

In your Shooting phase, each time a BRÔKHYR IRONKIN STEELJACKS or ARKANYST EVALUATOR unit from your army is selected to shoot, you can spend 1YP. If you do, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Fârstrydr Node
enhancements.rules_text: IRON-MASTER or MEMNYR STRATEGIST model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability.
restrictions: IRON-MASTER or MEMNYR STRATEGIST model only.

enhancements.name: Calculated Tenacity
enhancements.rules_text: IRON-MASTER or MEMNYR STRATEGIST model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.
restrictions: IRON-MASTER or MEMNYR STRATEGIST model only.

enhancements.name: Mantle of Elders
enhancements.rules_text: MEMNYR STRATEGIST model only. Each time the bearer's unit is selected to shoot, if you spend 1YP using the Optimal Application Detachment rule when doing so, you can roll one D6: on a 2+, you gain 1YP.

enhancements.name: Graviton Vault
enhancements.rules_text: IRON-MASTER model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, and in the Fight phase, after the bearer has fought, select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Unwavering Accuracy
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One BRÔKHYR THUNDERKYN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack's Ballistic Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll; that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic.

stratagems.name: First Concern
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a BRÔKHYR IRONKIN STEELJACKS or ARKANYST EVALUATOR unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That BRÔKHYR IRONKIN STEELJACKS or ARKANYST EVALUATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: If your unit Remained Stationary in your Movement phase this turn, it can make a Normal move.

stratagems.name: Delayed-Fire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a BRÔKHYR IRONKIN STEELJACKS or ARKANYST EVALUATOR unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.target: That BRÔKHYR IRONKIN STEELJACKS or ARKANYST EVALUATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, each time that enemy unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, roll one D6 for each model in that unit: for each 1, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.name: Wall of Steel
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after an IRONKIN STEELJACKS unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That IRONKIN STEELJACKS unit.
stratagems.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each model in your unit, rolling two additional D6 if you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.name: Preventative Purge
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One BRÔKHYR THUNDERKYN or IRONKIN STEELJACKS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase. When doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Cogitated Need
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One IRONKIN STEELJACKS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move. When doing so, your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker.

rule.name: Methodical Annihilation
rule.rules_text:
Each time a LEAGUES OF VOTANN model from your army makes an attack with a weapon that targets the closest eligible target or a target that is within Engagement Range of that model's unit:
- Re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
- If your unit is a KÂHL, EINHYR HEARTHGUARD or ÛTHAR THE DESTINED unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Bastion Shield
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Each time a ranged attack targets the bearer's unit, if the attacking model is within 12" of the bearer's unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If you spend 1YP, until the end of the phase, if the attacking model is within 18" of the bearer's unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1 instead.

enhancements.name: Quake Multigenerator
enhancements.rules_text: KÂHL model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit (excluding TITANIC units) hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Ironskin
enhancements.rules_text: LEAGUES OF VOTANN model only. Add 2 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic.

enhancements.name: High Kâhl
enhancements.rules_text: KÂHL model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Brêkkeknots
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One KÂHL, ÛTHAR THE DESTINED or EINHYR HEARTHGUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Sure of Purpose
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

rule.name: Ruthless Reinvestment
rule.rules_text: Your LEAGUES OF VOTANN units do not have the Hostile Acquisition or Fortify Takeover abilities except as described in this rule. At the start of the battle, your LEAGUES OF VOTANN units have the Hostile Acquisition ability. At the end of your Command phase, you can spend 3YP. If you do, LEAGUES OF VOTANN units from your army lose the Hostile Acquisition ability and gain the Fortify Takeover ability, or vice versa.
